title: Cannabis varieties
description: Everything in plant-variety/v1 applies. This adds the two things cannabis breeders record that other crops do not, and is here as a demonstration that a domain can extend the plant profile without anyone's permission and without changing it.

phenotypeSelection.description: Which phenotype was selected from a population, and on what basis.

chemotype.description: Cannabinoid or terpene profile as claimed. Substantiate with an attestation from a testing laboratory.
